A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same QSTar paper with 17 readable pages, including Appendix A. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical manuscript content apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original QSTar evaluations on MUSIC-AVQA and AVQA, including benchmark results, component ablations, and qualitative predictions in Section 4 and Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablation results, and qualitative predictions in Section 4 and Appendix A.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical QSTar architecture, query-guided multimodal correlation, spatial-temporal-frequency interaction, query context reasoning, and prediction procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use MUSIC-AVQA and AVQA with the same question categories and evaluation scenarios (Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1). No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same MUSIC-AVQA comparators, including TSPM and QA-TIGER. Table 4 retains PSAC, HCRN, PSTP, and TSPM for AVQA; the comparison variants in the ablation studies also match.

E3.justification: The data-split statement, accuracy metrics, preprocessing, encoders, and experimental settings are identical. Section 4.2 retains one-second segmentation, batch size 64, and 30 training epochs.

E4.justification: Ablations of modules, query guidance, feature processing, feature inputs, and prompting are unchanged (Tables 2, 3, 5, 6, and 8). The qualitative cases in Figures 3-5 are also identical.

E5.justification: Both versions report point accuracies without repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. No statistical reporting is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, rankings, and qualitative predictions match. QSTar retains 78.98% overall accuracy on MUSIC-AVQA (Table 1) and 90.9% without prompting or 91.2% with prompting on AVQA (Table 4).

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)-(14) are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about query guidance throughout the pipeline, frequency-aware interaction, contextual prompting, and state-of-the-art MUSIC-AVQA performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of benchmark results, ablations, and qualitative examples are unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same limitations concerning longer videos and the predefined question setting, along with the same proposed extensions.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain identical, including feature dimensions, AdamW settings, training budget, and H100 hardware in Section 4.2. Both versions still promise code and pretrained models after publication.

R1.justification: Section 2, the in-text citations, and the reference list match. The positioning relative to prior audio-visual question-answering methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 27 Jan 2026 to v2 dated 6 Mar 2026. This is a minor document-label edit; manuscript wording, authors, headings, and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1-5, Tables 1-8, captions, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2-17 are identical; page 1 differs only in the version/date stamp text.

improvement.justification: The complete manuscript, including Appendix A, retains the same scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
